test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

He worked alone as he did not want anyone to __hamper__ his project.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Hamper**' means to make something difficult(बाधा डालना)

 
 
• **Example**-His injured ankle **hampered **his ability to play basketball.
 
 
 
• '**Help**' means to make something better or easier(सहायता)
 
 
• **Example**-The doctor **helped **the patient recover from the illness.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of '**hamper**' is '**help**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Help**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences:

 
• **Finish**(खत्म करना):to complete something or reach the end of something

 
 
• **Example**-You can't watch TV until you **finish **your homework.
 
 
 
• **Care**(देखभाल):looking after somebody/something so that he/she/it has what he/she/it needs for his/her/its health and protection
 
 
• **Example**-The nurse provided excellent **care **to the patient.
 
 
 
• **Impede**(बाधा डालना):to make it difficult for somebody/something to move or go forward
 
 
• **Example**-The strict rules **impeded **the progress of the project.
 
 

5a:Tc48,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**</
